Design it here. No payment needed right now. Pick a patch shape and material, add your words or a picture, and send it. We'll review it, email you a proof to approve, then send a secure payment link. Your design is laser engraved on a leatherette patch and heat-pressed onto an Otto Cap 112 snapback trucker hat. Every patch is applied with a professional dual-heated platen heat press, with the right time, temperature and pressure for a clean, even, lasting bond.
